defs.def: very large or important 主要的；重要的；大的

ex.s: Throughout the Junior year, what was the author’s major concern?
ex.t: 在整个高三年级期间，作者主要担心的是什么？

ex.s: BMF’s major strengths.
ex.t: BMF的主要优势。

ex.s: It is a major tourist attraction.
ex.t: 它是一个主要旅游景点。

ex.s: One of the major headaches for her was finding her way in the huge school building.
ex.t: 对她来说，最头疼的事情之一就是在巨大的校舍里找路。

ex.s: It is fair to say, though, that our psychological biases play a major role.
ex.t: 不过，公平地说，我们的心理偏见起着主要作用。

ex.s: With help from Tesla, Westinghouse's firm developed a system using alternating current, which soon became the major forms of power delivery.
ex.t: 在特斯拉的帮助下，Westinghouse 的公司开发了一种使用交流电的系统，很快成为电力输送的主要形式。

ex.s: What is probably the major concern of travelers who choose to stay in a hostel?
ex.t: 选择住在旅店的旅行者的主要关切可能是什么？

ex.s: The project results from the difficulties many schools have in getting artists of any sort - whether an up-and-coming local musician or a major movie star - into schools to work with and inspire children.
ex.t: 该项目源于许多学校在邀请任何类型的艺术家——无论是崭露头角的本地音乐人还是大牌电影明星——进入学校与儿童合作并启发他们时所面临的困难。

ex.s: Their major functions.
ex.t: 它们的主要功能。

ex.s: Recently，I conceptualized a new approach to timekeeping that's connected to circumstances on our planet，conditions that might change as a result of global warming．We're now building a clock at the Anchorage Museum that reflects the total flow of several major Alaskan rivers，which are sensitive to local and global environmental changes．We've programmed it to match an atomic clock if the waterways continue to flow at their present rate．If the rivers run faster in the future on average，the clock will get ahead of standard time．If they run slower，you'll see the opposite effect．
ex.t: 最近，我构想了一种与地球环境状况相关的新计时方法，而这些状况可能因全球变暖而改变。我们现在正在安克雷奇博物馆建造一座时钟，它反映阿拉斯加几条主要河流的总流量，这些河流对地方和全球的环境变化十分敏感。我们已对它编程：如果水道继续以目前速率流动，它就与原子钟同步；如果未来河流平均流速加快，时钟就会跑在标准时间前面；如果变慢，则会出现相反效果。

ex.s: Time is a major concern of philosophers and scientists．
ex.t: 时间是哲学家和科学家主要关注的问题。

ex.s: When  50  my major life decisions, was still that little girl tearing full-speed across the lawn.
ex.t: 当____50__我重大的人生决定时，我还是那个全速冲过草坪的小女孩。

ex.s: What is a major cause of the water shortage according to Mclntyre?
ex.t: 根据麦金太尔，水资源短缺的一个主要原因是什么？

ex.s: Even their hairstyles became major trends at that time.
ex.t: 甚至她们的发型在当时也成了主要潮流。

ex.s: （1）According to Paragraph 1， what is the major goal of understanding history？
ex.t: （1）根据第1段，理解历史的主要目标是什么？

ex.s: This switch has decreased   66   (pollute) in the country’s major lakes and reservoirs and made drinking water safer for people.
ex.t: 这一转变减少了该国主要湖泊和水库的____66____（污染），并让人们饮用水更安全。

ex.s: By Rail: The nearest station is Cark-in-Cartmel with trains to Carnforth, Lancaster Preston for connections to major cities & airports.
ex.t: 乘火车：最近的车站是卡克因卡特梅尔，有开往卡恩弗斯、兰开斯特和普雷斯顿的列车，可转车前往主要城市和机场。

ex.s: As for driverless cars, what is the author’s major concern?
ex.t: 至于无人驾驶汽车，作者主要关心的是什么？

ex.s: In 1959, he took charge of Liverpool Football Club and established it as one of the major forces in the English and European football.
ex.t: 1959年，他接管了利物浦足球俱乐部，并将其确立为英格兰和欧洲足球的主要力量之一。

ex.s: Background information Vancouver is a major seaport on the coast of Southwestern British Columbia, Canada.
ex.t: 背景信息：温哥华是加拿大不列颠哥伦比亚省西南海岸的一个主要海港。

ex.s: In the 1980s, the team burst onto the international volleyball scene with several major world titles, and an amazing three-set victory over the United States in the final of the 1984 Los Angeles Olympics.
ex.t: 20世纪80年代，这支球队突然在国际排坛崭露头角，赢得了几个重要的世界冠军，并在1984年洛杉矶奥运会决赛中以惊人的三比零战胜美国。

ex.s: In the 1980s, the team suddenly became famous in the international volleyball scene with several major world titles, and they beat the United States three to zero in the final of the 1984 Los Angeles Olympics.
ex.t: 20世纪80年代，这支队伍突然在国际排球赛场上声名鹊起，获得了多个重要的世界冠军头衔，并在1984年洛杉矶奥运会决赛中以三比零击败了美国队。

ex.s: What is the major finding of the study regarding the appreciation of art?
ex.t: 关于艺术欣赏，这项研究的主要发现是什么？

ex.s: A major limitation of the study         D.
ex.t: 该研究的一个主要局限        D.

ex.s: Declining birth rate is a major problem in many developing regions too, which might cause catastrophic global shortages of work force within a few decades.
ex.t: 出生率下降在许多发展中地区也是一个重大问题，可能在几十年内导致全球劳动力的灾难性短缺。

ex.s: Color choices in this range are a step up from the small ones in two major ways
ex.t: 这一范围的色彩选择在小面积选择基础上有两个主要提升

defs.def: based on a scale (= a series of eight notes) in which the third note is two whole tones/steps higher than the first note 大调的

ex.s: Selected from collections throughout the world, it is the first major exhibition of his work to be held in over forty years.
ex.t: 这些作品选自世界各地收藏，这是四十多年来首次举办他的作品大型展览。

defs.def: related to sb's main subject of study in college （课程）主修的

ex.s: Your four major essays will combine to form the main part of the grade for this course: Essay 1 = 10%; Essay 2 = 15%; Essay 3 = 15%; Essay 4 = 20%.
ex.t: 你的四篇主要作文将构成本课程成绩的主要部分：作文1 = 10%；作文2 = 15%；作文3 = 15%；作文4 = 20%。

defs.def: an officer of fairly high rank in the army or the US air force 少校
the main subject or course of a student at college or university 主修课程；专业课

ex.s: Volunteering during teenage years has been linked to some major positive effects such as improved grades and increased self-confidence.
ex.t: 希望能给一些有才华的演员留下印象，让他们愿意免费为我工作，我在沙发上铺了一些毯子，点上蜡烛，让它看起来更像"年轻专业人士"的风格。

ex.s: The card holder has changed his or her major.
ex.t: 卡的主人更改了他或她的专业。

ex.s: Changing her major.
ex.t: 更换了专业。

defs.def: a student studying a particular subject as the main part of their course 主修学生；主修生
